findings.finding: The package contains no hosted Bucket-01 workflow. Exact-head execution and retained reports must be supplied separately without changing technical benchmark definitions.
The annular T6 generator is evaluated independently for geometry, Jacobian, connectivity, midside, symmetry and feature-set requirements.
Material, load and restraint coverage remains dependent on retained production execution.
The retained T6 patch covers distorted geometry, rigid motions, scaling, rotation and Jacobian rejection.
A frozen affine oracle and governed T3 receipt cover plane stress and plane strain, displacement, stress, energy, equilibrium and deterministic replay.
A frozen pure-shear oracle and governed receipt cover load-path parity, tensor and derived stress, energy, equilibrium and replay.
A frozen pure-bending T6 panel benchmark covers quadratic displacement, linear integration-point stress, energy and moment equilibrium.
The 64/256/1024 production ladder has force, moment, energy and GCI contracts plus a retained-result receipt.
Dense Cholesky is preserved below 1536 DOFs and deterministic CSR/Jacobi-PCG is used above; exact 1024-element lug execution remains unretained.
Fixed element-local probes reconstruct tensor components from retained T6 integration points without nodal projection or cross-element averaging.
Observed order, Richardson extrapolation, GCI, asymptotic checks and oscillatory/non-monotonic blocking are implemented.
The governed T6 Kirsch benchmark uses frozen off-boundary probes and fixed-coordinate GCI against a closed-form oracle.
Two standalone production-lug probes and a five-station radial stress path are frozen before stress observation and map uniquely inside one T6 element at every 64/256/1024 level.

A retained-result receipt reconstructs stress at all frozen production-lug locations and requires zone-specific three-level GCI. No production stress values or PASS are claimed until exact execution results are supplied.

A fail-closed code-basis intake contract now requires an externally approved governing code and edition, source-document hash, allowable and temperature basis, fixed-location stress classification, explicit load-combination terms and approval-record hash. The committed template remains UNRESOLVED_GATE; no code, allowable, classification or combination is selected or inferred.
The final exact candidate requires three clean deterministic executions with retained report-data hashes.
